Add the First Route
So let's start by creating a home page and routing it. We'll divide the process into three steps.
Step 1: Create a Home Page
We'll move all the journal list logic in App.jsx into a new file named HomePage.jsx. We'll keep this file in its own pages component folder.
We'll also remove the selectedEntry state from HomePage because we'll no longer need it (we'll remove Drawer.jsx in the next step).
Instead, clicking an entry will navigate to a URL that gives the entry details. We'll wire that up in the next lesson, not now.
Therefore, App.jsx will remain unchanged; we'll change it in the next step.
1/* Daily Journal App — React Hooks edition css goes here */
Click Run Code and you should see the HomePage.jsx file created on the code editor. But we haven't wired it to our app.
Let's do that next!
